name: Rotting Orchard
summary: Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, where ravenous lupine predators of the Nightbane pack have overrun the abandoned grove. Once it supplied fruit to nearby Darkshire, but now its trees and buildings lie in ruin.

sections.title: Den of the Nightbane
sections.body: In the Rotting Orchard, Nightbane worgen have made camps among the ruined barns and outbuildings. The orchard lies east of the ruined Yorgen Farmstead and west of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Withered fruit hangs from its trees, and Nightbane Stalkers prowl the twisted brush. Nightbane Shadow Weavers practice their dark magic among the decaying timber. The fierce worgen Gutspill and Nefaru lead the pack from their lair in the nearby mine of Roland's Doom.

faq.q: What creatures occupy the Rotting Orchard?
faq.answer: Ravenous worgen of the Nightbane pack occupy the orchard. Nightbane Stalkers prowl its brush, while Nightbane Shadow Weavers cast dark spells among the trees and buildings.

faq.q: Where is the Rotting Orchard located in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The Rotting Orchard lies in southern Duskwood, southwest of the town of Darkshire. It sits between the ruined Yorgen Farmstead to the west and Tranquil Gardens Cemetery to the east.

faq.q: Who leads the worgen in this orchard?
faq.answer: Gutspill and Nefaru lead the Nightbane worgen from their lair in the mine of Roland's Doom, just east of the orchard.

faq.q: Was this place always overrun by monsters?
faq.answer: No. The orchard was once a productive farm and fruit grove that supported the local human populace. Dark curses and supernatural horrors overtook the region and drove the farmers away.

angles.text: The Nightbane worgen pose a direct predatory threat to the fragile security of Darkshire, just up the road.
The twisted trees and ruined outbuildings offer good ground for stalking, but the Nightbane pack's keen senses and spellcraft make every approach dangerous.
